body.input: You have two tasks. Task 1: Call execute-tool with toolName='self-instance-id', callbackMode='detach', input={}. This returns a taskId immediately. Remember the taskId value. Task 2: After task 1, call complete-task with taskId=<value from task 1> and response={status:'completed',output:'manual-complete-test'}. The result should have completed=true. End your response with STEP_OK if both calls succeeded, or FAILED: <reason> if not.
